functions.evidence: Returns whether the BSP image pointer (0x08188da8) is non-NULL; IW/CoD4 lineage Com_IsBspLoaded. Callers BspFile_FreeIfLoaded.
Returns BSP image pointer and optional length/checksum out-params; counterpart of IW Com_GetBsp* accessors (CoD4 lineage, name not verified in binary).
Reads map via FS_OpenFileRead, errors "EXE_ERR_COULDNT_LOAD" / "EXE_ERR_WRONG_MAP_VERSION_NUM", checks magic 0x50534249 "IBSP" version 4, byte-swaps 39 lump entries; IW Com_LoadBsp counterpart.
Frees BSP image via Com_Free_A and clears pointer 0x08188da8; paired with Com_LoadBsp.
Calls unload only when BspFile_IsLoaded(); called from Com_ErrorRecover.
sprintf "%s %s" of "pc_1.3_1_1" and "Mon May 01 2006 05:05:43PM" into g_08a6f440 (observed strings).
Single-instruction-body thunk calling Cbuf_Execute; replaces Wrapper-style name.
Body only calls Cmd_ExecuteString(text); sole caller SVC_RemoteCommand (0x0809745a).
Body only calls Com_ServerShutdown(msg); duplicate entry of that function.
Looks up command by name and stores two words (dir, ext) into the command record at +8/+0xc; CoD4 lineage Cmd_SetAutoComplete(cmdName, dir, ext).
Stores float bits into g_081a2270, which Com_ModifyMsec multiplies with com_timescale (fld/fmul at 0x080625d1/0x080625f1) and Com_Init sets to 1.0f.
16-bit sign-extension identity used only by MSG_WriteShort (0x080680be) and MSG_ReadShort (0x08068421); id Tech 3 LittleShort on a little-endian host.
32-bit identity used only by MSG_WriteLong (0x0806810d) and MSG_ReadLong (0x0806847e); id Tech 3 LittleLong on little-endian host.
32-bit identity; sole caller Netchan_Process (0x0806c2d2) at the sequence read, matching Q3 LittleLong(*(int*)msg->data).
Body identical to Str_NCaseCmp (0x080ad4dc): tolower compare, -1/0/1, same n==0 / *a==0 handling; ICF-style duplicate; caller SV_UnbanUserByName.
Returns c-0x30 for digits 0-9 else 7; sole caller ClientCleanName (0x080f8b9b); counterpart of Q3 ColorIndex (digit -> colour index) with CoD2 default 7.
Computes t*(2-|t|) (quadratic ease-out mirrored for negative t); callers BG_PlayerAngles, PlayerView_ComputeSway, WeaponView_ApplyTimedKickB, Rotate_Eased.
Computes 1-sqrt(1-t), the exact inverse of t*(2-t) on [0,1]; sole caller PM_UpdateLean.

Eases t, builds a rotation about the given axis scaled by angleScale and adds the result scaled by blendScale to dst; callers PM_UpdateLean, G_GetPlayerViewOrigin, SV_BuildClientSnapshot. Lean semantics inferred from callers only.
out = origin(frame[0..2]) + in rotated by 3x3 block frame[3..11]; caller Orient_Concat.
strcpy wrapper whose address is passed as the string-copy callback in G_ParseHitLocDmgTable (0x0810159b).
Forwards size to Hunk_AllocLow; address stored as allocator callback in G_InitGame (0x087035b8 write) and passed in Pool_AllocGameObjects.
Tail thunk to LocTable_Create; callers FS_InitFilesystem, FS_Restart.
Tail thunk to LocTable_Destroy; caller FS_Shutdown.
Address pushed as the init argument (before fini 0x0813e290) to __libc_start_main in _start (0x0804a6d0); body calls .init and ctors: glibc crt csu init.
Empty handler registered with Cmd_AddCommand("in_restart") in Sys_InitCvars (0x080d3adc); Q3 unix_main Sys_In_Restart_f counterpart.
Executes fnstcw into a dead local; sole caller main (0x080d5102); Q3 linux Sys_ConfigureFPU counterpart (inferred, weak).
Walks all 256 hash buckets under critical section 4 and writes name\0value\0 pairs for dvars matching a flag mask (buf==NULL measures length); IW/CoD4 lineage Dvar_GetCombinedString.
Parses name\0value\0 pairs over [buf,buf+len): known dvar -> Dvar_SetVariant, unknown -> Dvar_RegisterString flags 0x4000; counterpart of Dvar_GetCombinedString.
Walks dvar_vars under critical section 4 and calls Dvar_ResetToDefault for dvars whose flags match the mask.
snprintf "%s \"%s\"\n" for each named dvar into buf; returns 1 on success, 0 on snprintf failure (observed format).
Resets named dvars, parses file tokens, applies values with Dvar_SetFromString; prints "^1ERROR: the following dvars were not specified in file '%s'" (observed).
If dvar missing registers string "%g %g %g %g" with flags 0x4000 else Dvar_SetVec4.
